messages.content: Generate an original instrumental background music track for a cozy Chinese Mid-Autumn dice board game. Warm intimate tabletop atmosphere, moderate tempo around 96 BPM, restrained dynamics so game sound effects stay audible. No vocals, no lyrics, no speech, no crowd noise, no heavy drums. Aim for a 60-second piece suitable for looping. Title: Moonlit Dice Table. Please generate the actual audio and return its download link.
